input.body:
label: feature
file: src/export/csv.ts

Currently, the exports only support CSV and XLSX formats via modules in src/export/. The writeCsv function in src/export/csv.ts handles CSV export using a delimiter (likely comma) and BOM for UTF-8. To implement TSV export, a similar approach can be taken by adding a new export function that outputs tab-delimited text (using `\t` as delimiter) and returns an ExportFile with an appropriate content type (e.g., 'text/tab-separated-values'). The existing export API would need to extend to accept a 'tsv' format and route to the new writer function. This feature would allow direct TSV exports without manual post-processing, avoiding issues with commas inside fields.
